items.title: Warning signs of a scam. Don't pay or share anything
reasons: It follows the pattern of a known scam: Money-doubling / unregulated deposit scheme.
It asks for money while pushing guaranteed returns.
It promises guaranteed returns. SEBI-registered advisers cannot promise guaranteed returns.

items.title: Warning signs of a scam. Don't pay or share anything
reasons: It follows the pattern of a known scam: KYC update / account block phishing.
It threatens arrest, a block or legal action.
It pushes you to act immediately.
